chunks: From him, from his father, from Hammad, from Hariz, from Ibn Muslim, who said:
I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about the Friday prayer, so he said: 'It is obligatory upon whoever is within two farsakhs of it; if he exceeds that, there is no obligation upon him.'
ai.seo_question: What is the distance limit for the obligation of Friday prayer in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) defines the geographical limit for the obligation of Friday prayer as two farsakhs, reflecting the practical considerations of travel ease in the early Islamic period. It highlights the Shia jurisprudential principle of removing hardship (raf' al-haraj) by exempting those residing beyond this specific radius, thereby distinguishing the mandatory communal prayer from the individual noon prayer (Dhuhr).
